story: To save money it required towns of fewer than 1,000 people to merge with their neighbours.

To save money it was reported to require towns of fewer than 1,000 people to merge with their neighbours. Italy's Constitutional Court later said the law, Article 16 of Decree-Law 138/2011, did not provide for the merger or extinction of small towns. It required them to run their administration jointly through a union of towns.
although the government was pressing the town to share services.
